components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 28px; background: #f5a623; color: #1e293b; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.15); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #c2741a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(245,166,35,0.6); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: wait; }

components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #334155; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #3a4f7a; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(245,166,35,0.6); }

components.name: Screenshot Frame

components.css: .ds-shot { margin: 0; } .ds-shot-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; background: #16223a; border-bottom: 1px solid #24355c; } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f5a623; } .ds-shot-bar span:nth-child(2) { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); } .ds-shot-label { margin-left: auto; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-shot-body { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0 0 12px 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-top: none; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.18); } .ds-shot-body img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }

narrative.overview:
Property NI's landing page reads like the front of a well-run operations room: dark navy chrome frames light work surfaces, and everything is labelled plainly. The system is calm and precise — institutional in its discipline, warm only where it matters. There is exactly one accent color, and it behaves like a door handle: it appears on the CTA, on focus rings, and as thin framing edges that mark "this is the entrance." Nothing glows, nothing animates for decoration; motion exists to confirm scroll position, not to entertain.

The page alternates full-bleed navy bands (hero, onboarding, contact) with white working surfaces (role strip, product tour, AI integration). Product screenshots never appear raw — they are always wrapped in a framed chrome that makes them read as the real portal, not stock imagery. Density is moderate: generous section padding (80–112px vertical), 65ch reading measures, and grid gaps wide enough that sections breathe without feeling empty.
keyCharacteristics: Navy chrome / white work-surface alternation as the page's structural rhythm
A single amber accent reserved for action and focus — never decoration
Sora display over Inter body: confident headings, plain-spoken text
Every product screenshot framed in portal chrome with a navy top bar
Flat surfaces; shadows only to lift framed content off the page

rules.name: The Amber Door Rule
rules.body: Amber appears only where a user acts or focuses: CTAs, focus rings, and the thin edges that mark an entry point (form card border, hero frame border). It never fills a band, never decorates a heading, and never carries white text. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Chrome Rule
rules.body: Dark navy is chrome — it frames and grounds (hero, onboarding, contact, footer, portal bars). Light surfaces are where content lives. A section is either framed or working; it does not mix both in one surface.

rules.name: The Plain-Spoken Rule
rules.body: Copy names concrete things ("no phone calls, no email threads"). Type settings reinforce it: no gradient text, no italic emphasis, no display sizes below section level. If a sentence needs shouting, rewrite it.

rules.name: The Framed-Content Rule
rules.body: Shadows follow frames: anything wrapped in portal chrome (screenshots, the contact form) carries a shadow; flat sections never do. A shadow without a frame is decoration and does not ship.

dos: Do alternate navy chrome bands and white working surfaces; keep each section one or the other.
Do frame every product screenshot in the portal-bar card with the Frame shadow.
Do use amber only for action and focus (CTA, focus rings, door borders), with dark-slate ink on top.
Do cap body copy at ~65ch and keep section padding 80–112px so bands breathe.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: reveals render visible with no transition.
donts: Don't put white text on amber; the accent's ink is dark slate, always.
Don't add a second accent color or use amber as a fill, background band, or heading treatment.
Don't place screenshots bare on the page without the portal-bar frame.
Don't introduce shadows on flat sections; shadows follow frames only.
Don't animate for decoration — motion is scroll-reveal and state confirmation only.
